query.title: Company name or registration number
query.description: A single company name (or partial name) or Samoa registration number (e.g. 0456) to search for.

queries.title: Company names or registration numbers
queries.description: Multiple names/registration numbers to search for in one run. Combined with 'query' if both are set.

fetchDetails.title: Fetch full company profile
fetchDetails.description: When on (default), each matched company is opened to pull its full public profile -- addresses, directors, shareholders, share parcels, and filing history. When off, only the search-result summary (name, registration number, status, incorporation date) is returned, which is faster for a broad name search.

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max matches per query
maxResultsPerQuery.description: Maximum number of matched companies to return (and, if enabled, fetch full profiles for) per search query. The register shows 10 results per page; this actor pages through up to 10 pages (100 results) automatically.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers
maxConcurrency.description: How many search sessions / detail-page fetches to run in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Residential is on by default.
